title: An Unknown Face Used to Mean Free TV | vitalii.no
description:
A face the camera didn't recognize could sit in front of the TV for hours and nothing happened — the gate only ever reacted to faces it knew. On 4 October it logged exactly that: an unknown face on screen for four hours, while the child it did recognize was only in frame for one minute.

The presence check in workers/youtube-gate/index.js now raises an 'unknown' offender whenever the TV is unlocked, a child still owes today's set, and the camera reports an unrecognized face with no recent grace period. TvPage.tsx shows a "Хто ти?" prompt naming every child covered by the check: anyone who hasn't finished gets the normal lock screen, anyone who has finished must confirm with a PIN through a new /unknown-answer endpoint, and an adult clears it with the existing parent code.

The unknown face had four hours of free, unquestioned screen time; the real child, one minute. Now every face on camera has to answer who it is.
